expected: each local port-forward must be demonstrably bound to its intended backend before queries
first_divergence: collector readiness/query accepted an already-listening Scenario B port while the Scenario A port-forward could not bind
root_cause: A fixed local port collision hid by discarded port-forward output caused Jaeger B responses to be stored as Jaeger A
evidence: old manifests recorded Jaeger A queries against 127.0.0.1:16686 and Jaeger B against 127.0.0.1:16687
read-only process/socket inspection during diagnosis showed Jaeger B bound to 16686 and Jaeger A bound to 16688
corrected historical queries through separately confirmed dynamic forwards returned distinct A/B trace populations
corrected manifests record six distinct local ports and BOUND_TO_EXPECTED_SERVICE_PORT for all backend processes
fix: allocate ephemeral local ports, capture kubectl output, require exact local/remote binding confirmation, and verify process liveness

invalidated_signals: Scenario A Jaeger traces in original bundles

working_tree_note: incident report records an already corrected collector commit; no application or observability changes were made for this incident
